admission.justification: The sidecar store, shared window-scoped projection, causal MCP tool-call hook, runtime CLI adapter, recheck claim, serialized write, delivery order, clear marker, pending-only plugin check, and documentation each fail reliable seat release alone: a suppression without sidecar persistence re-imposes on the next tick, a projection without clear markers waits for the old deadline, and an unguarded hook would clear genuine limits from pre-limit turns.

guarantee: When the host reports that a provider limit ended early, or when a falsely reported exhausted window (reportId, windowId, resetsAt) is suppressed until its reset—automatically by a bound seat's post-limit live turn or explicitly via agents-remember provider-limits—the product maintains per-window recordedAt and suppressions in provider-limit-suppressions.json under provider-limits.lock, projects remaining unsuppressed windows onto strictly ar-provider-limits/v1 provider-limits.json (recomputing until or dropping the report with clearedSeats), drains eligible held messages in recorded order, and releases pending resume and parent flush within one fifteen-second check period while Paseo usage reports remain the sole limit creator.
title: Early limit resets and window-scoped suppressions reach seats reliably
